info.title: DeepStack API
info.summary: The money behind the machine, as static JSON.
info.description: Static files written by the DeepStack site build (generated 2026-10-10T05:15:07Z). No key and no rate limit; every object carries its canonical url, generatedAt and the line "Analysis and opinion, not investment advice.". GitHub Pages serves every file with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *, so a browser can read the API from any origin; no CORS configuration exists or is needed for these static files. The same content is available to agents over the Model Context Protocol at https://mcp.deepstack.ltd/mcp, documented at https://deepstack.ltd/mcp/.

side.description: The side the Call took in this version (the label of a side of the story’s sides page), or null for a synthesis of two sides; present only on versions made since the side was named.

reason.description: Why this version was made; version 1 is the call made with the story.

side.description: The side the Call takes: the label of one side of the story’s sides page, or null when the Call is a synthesis of two sides; absent until the owner names it.

against.description: The strongest case against the side the Call takes, the same object the sides page carries for that side; null for a synthesis or when no case has cleared the bar; absent with `side`.

version.description: The current version of the Call; it rises when a result changes the stance, the conviction or the line, or when the owner names the side.

updatedOn.description: The day the current version was made.

history.description: Every version of the Call, ascending; the last entry equals the current state.

corrections.description: The dated correction notices printed at the top of the story, newest first; empty when none.

url.description: The Result page, /results/<id>/: what we said, the rule, what happened, what changes.

anchorUrl.description: The same result as a card on /results/.

resolutionPackage.description: The one-page resolution package (PDF): question, rule, official source, ambiguity clause, evidence, verdict, approver and date; null while no file exists.
